metadata.description: General-purpose Claude Code skills — versioned, validated, installable. Domain-agnostic authoring aids that aren't tied to any one plugin's job, distributed as cohesive skill-bundle plugins.

plugins.name: design-skills
plugins.description: Design-domain skills across three vintages. Crossing-axis DECOMPOSERS: layout-decomposer (UI layout on OUTSIDE-IN x INSIDE-OUT + a four-archetype ASCII-wireframe library), mermaid-decomposer (advanced Mermaid on INTENT x RENDER + an 11-type catalog + a mechanized render-check), component-decomposer (a zero-dependency web component AND how components compose — nest/wire — up to the module, on COMPOSE x REALIZE + the (height-glyph)/2 geometry engine + contract & composition linters; hands the app shell up to layout-decomposer). REFERENCE skills: color-science (perceptual color + a TypeScript color library + 54 demos), typography-lettering (type anatomy → world scripts → the modern CSS text surface), ref-polyfills (CSS/JS feature support, polyfills/shims, feature-detection, the Baseline landscape). VERIFIERS: color-verifier, focus-verifier, i18n-verifier, perf-verifier, safety-verifier (gate a UI surface on contrast/CVD, focus order, internationalization, performance budgets, and safety). Skills only — no commands, agents, or MCP. Self-contained.

plugins.name: code-skills
plugins.description: Engineering-domain skills: code-decomposer (grade a unit of code on SPEC x EXECUTION — right + provably runs — with an execution harness and a test-vacuity linter that attacks the 'green but wrong' quadrant), regex-decomposer (grade a regex on LANGUAGE x MATCH — means the right language and won't ReDoS — with an example-set + ReDoS checker), query-decomposer (grade a SQL query on SEMANTICS x EXECUTION — right grain, actually plans — with a SQL linter and an EXPLAIN/dry-run harness), type-decomposer (grade a type/schema on MODEL x VALIDITY — make illegal states unrepresentable — with a JSON-Schema validator that runs legal/illegal instance sets, plus a model-smell linter), architecture-decomposer (grade a system architecture on STRUCTURE x INTEGRITY — right decomposition AND a dependency graph that actually holds — with an acyclicity/layering/coupling checker), and figma-plugins (build, review, and test Figma plugins across the sandbox<->iframe message bridge). Skills only — self-contained.

plugins.name: data-skills
plugins.description: Data-domain skills: extraction-decomposer (decompose/design/grade a structured extraction on FIDELITY x VALIDITY axes — is the JSON both schema-valid and true to the source — scored separately, with a deterministic groundedness check that catches the invented values a schema gate can't see; the instructive inversion — gate validity, adversarially verify fidelity).

plugins.name: meta-skills
plugins.description: Meta-domain skills (skills about skills): routing-decomposer (decompose/design/grade a skill's frontmatter description on INSTRUCTION x ROUTING axes — does it say the right thing AND fire on the right cases, not over- or under-trigger — scored separately, with a mechanized precision/recall/F1 routing-eval over a labeled corpus plus a description linter).

plugins.name: reasoning-skills
plugins.description: Reasoning-domain skills: proof-decomposer (decompose/design/grade a deductive argument or math proof on ARGUMENT x VERIFICATION axes — are the steps valid AND do they prove the stated claim, not a subtly different one — scored separately, with a proof-structure checker that catches circular reasoning, dangling citations, and unreachable goals, plus a numeric counterexample search).

plugins.name: ops-skills
plugins.description: Operations-domain skills: config-decomposer (decompose/design/grade a config or infrastructure-as-code artifact on INTENT x VALIDITY axes — does it declare the right desired-state AND validate/plan cleanly, not provision the wrong thing — scored separately, with a validate/plan harness, a safety linter for plaintext secrets, :latest, and wide-open permissions, and the plan-is-the-contract doctrine).

plugins.name: general-skills
plugins.description: Domain-agnostic, general-purpose skills — reusable across any project, tied to no single domain. research-survey (systematic investigation & optimization: bisect, ablation, hill-climb, adversarial probe, sweep, root-cause), viz-2x2 (build and critique a 2x2 matrix — axis independence, quadrant balance, placement), and tool-stress (stress-test a tool / MCP interface for an agent). Skills only — no commands, agents, or MCP. Self-contained.

plugins.name: knowledge-skills
plugins.description: Knowledge-authoring skills — building and maintaining knowledge bases and reference corpora. meta-expert-author (author comprehensive [domain]-expert skills via wave-based parallel-agent research-survey, with tiered citations), meta-theory-author (peer-reviewed-source theory skills), plan-knowledge (stand up a project knowledge base), and ops-knowledge (capture and structure operational knowledge). Skills only — no commands, agents, or MCP. Self-contained.

plugins.name: manager-skills
plugins.description: Management & communication skills — executive writing and reporting tools. The report family — report-brief (a tight decision brief), report-progress (progress / status update), report-state (a state-of report), report-strategic (a strategic brief) — plus resume-author (resumes / CVs). Writing tools for leadership communication: exec summaries, status, briefs. Skills only — no commands, agents, or MCP. Self-contained.

plugins.name: skills-skills
plugins.description: Skills for authoring and optimizing Claude Code SKILLS — the meta-tooling for the skill ecosystem itself. skills-studio (the skill lifecycle: author / edit / optimize, score against the best-practices rubric, the 9-critic adversarial council, behavioral evals, routing corpora), skills-refactor (refactor or split an existing skill), and meta-app-scaffold (scaffold a skill / reference-app foundation). Skills only — no commands, agents, or MCP. Self-contained.

plugins.name: plugins-skills
plugins.description: Skills for authoring, reviewing, and optimizing Claude Code PLUGINS. plugin-decomposer (decompose, design, and grade a plugin on the BUNDLE x MANIFEST axes — is it the right focused set of components for one job, AND does it actually install and load — scored separately, with a deterministic plugin-manifest linter that catches malformed manifests, illegal/escaping paths, bad names/versions, unresolved marketplace entries, and the kitchen-sink bundle). The nonoun-native peer to the global plugins-factory. Skills only — no commands, agents, or MCP. Self-contained.
